description: This file defines the OrderServices class providing a set of service methods related to order processing in the OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities for creating orders, permission checks, inventory management, and various order-related utilities.

classes.name: OrderServices
classes.description: Provides various static methods to manage order creation, permission checks, and inventory reservation within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrderServices
classes.description: Provides various static methods to manage order creation, permission checks, inventory reservation, status updates, shipping, notifications, and fulfillment within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform a specific action on an order, considering order type, parties involved, and security roles.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Service for creating a new order with all associated data such as order items, attributes, notes, roles, and inventory reservations.

methods.name: countProductQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Counts total quantity ordered for a specific product, updating ProductCalculatedInfo accordingly.

methods.name: uctQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Updates or creates the ProductCalculatedInfo record for a product with the total quantity ordered; handles virtual product variants and triggers recursive counting accordingly.

methods.name: reserveInventory
methods.description: Handles inventory reservations for order items, considering store settings and product types, and reserves stock by calling reserveStoreInventory service, including handling marketing packages and rental items.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Retrieves the product's name or fallback item description.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityFromOrder
methods.description: Determines the appropriate facility for an order based on its header's store ID and associated store configuration.

methods.name: resetGrandTotal
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the grand total of an order header, considering taxes and subtotals and store configurations.

methods.name: setEmptyGrandTotals
methods.description: Finds orders with null grandTotal and remainingSubTotal, then recalculates and updates these totals, optionally forcing all orders.

methods.name: recalcOrderTax
methods.description: Recomputes tax adjustments for an order, invoking the calcTax service, adjusting for manual overrides, and creating adjustment records if needed.

methods.name: recalcOrderShipping
methods.description: Recomputes shipping totals based on shipping estimates, and creates order adjustments for changes.

methods.name: checkItemStatus
methods.description: Checks if all items in an order are canceled, completed, or approved, then updates order status accordingly.

methods.name: cancelOrderItem
methods.description: Cancels quantities in order items, adjusting for receipt or shipment status, verifying permissions, and handling related associations.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with associated data such as items, notes, roles, and inventory reservations.

methods.name: countProductQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Counts total quantity ordered for a specific product and updates ProductCalculatedInfo accordingly.

methods.name: uctQuantityOrdered
methods.description: Updates or creates ProductCalculatedInfo records for products with total quantity ordered; handles virtual variants and recursive counting.

methods.name: reserveInventory
methods.description: Reserves stock for order items, considering product types and store settings, invoking reserveStoreInventory service, including handling marketing packages and rentals.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Retrieves the product’s name or fallback description for an order item.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityFromOrder
methods.description: Determines the appropriate facility for an order based on the order header's store ID and store configuration.

methods.name: resetGrandTotal
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the grand total of an order header, accounting for taxes, subtotals, and store settings.

methods.name: setEmptyGrandTotals
methods.description: Finds orders with null grandTotal and remainingSubTotal, recalculates, and updates totals, optionally forcing all orders.

methods.name: recalcOrderTax
methods.description: Recomputes tax adjustments for an order, invoking calcTax service, handling manual overrides, and creating adjustment records.

methods.name: recalcOrderShipping
methods.description: Recomputes shipping totals based on estimates, creating adjustments for changes.

methods.name: checkItemStatus
methods.description: Checks if all items in an order are canceled, completed, or approved, then updates order status.

methods.name: cancelOrderItem
methods.description: Cancels quantities in order items, adjusting for shipment receipt status, verifying permissions, and updating associations.

methods.name: processOrderPayments
methods.description: Processes payments for an order, handling scenarios like purchase orders and normal payments, including payment creation and validation.

methods.name: shoppingCartTest
methods.description: Test service that creates a shopping cart, adds an item, and runs an async remote test.

methods.name: shoppingCartRemoteTest
methods.description: Test service that logs product ID from a shopping cart.

methods.name: createPaymentFromPreference
methods.description: Creates a payment record based on a stored payment preference, setting payment method and related info.

methods.name: massChangeApproved
methods.description: Bulk updates orders to approved status.

methods.name: massCancelOrders
methods.description: Bulk cancels multiple orders.

methods.name: massRejectOrders
methods.description: Bulk rejects multiple orders.

methods.name: massHoldOrders
methods.description: Bulk puts multiple orders on hold.

methods.name: massProcessOrders
methods.description: Bulk updates orders to processing status.

methods.name: massChangeOrderStatus
methods.description: Bulk updates order statuses to a specified status.

methods.name: massChangeItemStatus
methods.description: Bulk updates item statuses across orders.

methods.name: massQuickShipOrders
methods.description: Bulk processes quick shipping for orders.

methods.name: massPickOrders
methods.description: Creates pick lists grouped by facility for orders.

methods.name: massPrintOrders
methods.description: Prints orders in bulk, either directly or via specified screen/printer.

methods.name: massCreateFileForOrders
methods.description: Creates files for orders in bulk for external processing.

methods.name: massCancelRemainingPurchaseOrderItems
methods.description: Cancels remaining unreceived quantities for purchase order items.

methods.name: checkCreateDropShipPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Creates drop ship purchase orders for sales orders with drop shipment groups.

methods.name: updateOrderPaymentPreference
methods.description: Updates or creates an order payment preference with new payment info.

methods.name: generateReqsFromCancelledPOItems
methods.description: Generates product requirements based on canceled purchase order items.

methods.name: cancelRemainingPurchaseOrderItems
methods.description: Cancels remaining unreceived quantities on purchase orders, then checks item status.

methods.name: createSimpleNonProductSalesOrder
methods.description: Creates a simple sales order without products, using item map and payment method.

methods.name: createOrderFromShoppingCart
methods.description: Creates an order entity based on a shopping cart object.

methods.name: callProcessOrderPayments
methods.description: Processes an order’s payments, potentially suspending transactions for order processing and reactivity.

methods.name: getOrderItemInvoicedAmountAndQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total invoiced amount and quantity for an order item, considering all related billings and adjustments.

methods.name: setOrderPaymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the payment status of an order payment preference, including status change and record creation.

methods.name: setOrderPaymentStatus
methods.description: Sets the payment status of an order, creating a new status record if it differs from the previous one.

methods.name: runSubscriptionAutoReorders
methods.description: Automates reordering based on subscription data, creating orders for active subscriptions whose end date has passed.

methods.name: addOrderItemShipGroup
methods.description: Creates an OrderItemShipGroup record, with validation of carrier and shipment method.

methods.name: deleteOrderItemShipGroup
methods.description: Removes an OrderItemShipGroup record associated with an order.

methods.name: addOrderItemShipGroupAssoc
methods.description: Creates an association between an order item and a shipment group with quantity validation and inventory reservation.

methods.name: updateOrderItemShipGroupAssoc
methods.description: Updates or deletes an existing association between an order item and a shipment group; handles quantity changes and inventory adjustments.

methods.name: validateOrderItemShipGroupAssoc
methods.description: Validates and adjusts OrderItemShipGroupAssoc quantities to align with the parent OrderItem quantity, and manages inventory reservation accordingly.

methods.name: setShippingInstructions
methods.description: Sets the shipping instructions for a specific order item's shipment group.

methods.name: setGiftMessage
methods.description: Sets a gift message and flag for a shipment group.

methods.name: createAlsoBoughtProductAssocs
methods.description: Creates 'also bought' product associations for orders in a specific date range, expiring old associations if processing all orders.

methods.name: createAlsoBoughtProductAssocsForOrder
methods.description: Generates 'also bought' associations for products in a specific order, creating or updating association records.

methods.name: updateShipGroupShipInfo
methods.description: Updates shipping method, carrier, and address information for a shipment group, including revalidation against available shipping methods.

methods.name: associateOrderWithAllocationPlans
methods.description: Creates or updates allocation plans for order items, establishing planning structure for inventory allocations.

methods.name: approveAllocationPlanItems
methods.description: Approves allocation plan items, re-reserves inventory, and updates order status accordingly.

methods.name: cancelAllocationPlanItems
methods.description: Cancels specified allocation plan items, freeing inventory and updating statuses.
